resources.configuration: Pinned version, architecture and content digest; installed state
resources.update: New content/version is a new immutable installation
resources.readiness: Verified installed digest and architecture
resources.removal: Remove only owned unused artifact; retain borrowed installations

resources.configuration: Catalog/package/OCI source, immutable boot inputs, alias and installed state
resources.update: New immutable version; alias changes never mutate admitted VM pins
resources.readiness: Verified boot artifacts available for target architecture
resources.removal: Retain versions referenced by workloads

resources.configuration: Registered path/device and capacity metadata; unregister without formatting or erasing borrowed data
resources.update: Metadata in place; path/device change requires explicit replacement
resources.readiness: Registered accessible root and validated capacity
resources.removal: Unregister only when unused; never format or erase borrowed data

resources.configuration: Name, size, filesystem identity and explicit data-retention policy
resources.update: Follow baseline immutability; size/filesystem replacement needs data consent
resources.readiness: Verified on-disk identity; no conflicting writer
resources.removal: Retain data artifact and discoverable identity unless deletion authorized

resources.removal: Delete only when all owned dependents are removed and no external users remain

resources.configuration: Name, network and ordered ingress/egress rules
resources.update: Rules/name in place; network change requires replacement
resources.readiness: Rules validated and applied to intended network
resources.removal: Reject removal while referenced; do not weaken another owner's VM policy

resources.configuration: Named scripts and immutable revision/content identities; assignment does not rerun scripts on refresh
resources.update: Create a new immutable revision; explicit VM revision reassignment
resources.readiness: Content checksum and revision available
resources.removal: Retain revisions still referenced; no command execution on refresh

resources.configuration: CPU, RAM, disk, env, egress, shell pins, port forwards and desired running/stopped state

resources.removal: Stop own VM; retain root data by default and detach retained data volumes

resources.update: Follow mutable pool fields; incompatible template changes plan replacement

resources.removal: Release only parent-owned members; borrowed images/networks remain

resources.configuration: Start/stop action, one-time or cron timing, time zone and enabled state

resources.removal: Disable and delete schedule; preserve VM and run history policy
